context_for_next_testing_agent: Email Digest feature fully tested (Iteration 6): 1) GET /api/email/preferences returns default {weekly_digest: true, reminder_alerts: true}, preferences stored in MongoDB user doc under 'email_preferences' field. 2) PUT /api/email/preferences updates and persists to MongoDB. 3) POST /api/email/preview-digest generates HTML email with gradient header, 6 stat cards (Tasks Done, Created, Rate, Chats, Messages, Reminders), and upcoming tasks section. 4) POST /api/email/send-digest returns graceful error {success: false, message: 'Email service not configured...'} when RESEND_API_KEY not set. Frontend Profile page has email-digest-section with two toggles, Preview Digest button (opens iframe), and Send Now button. All data-testid attributes properly implemented.

preview_digest_api.details: Returns HTML string with gradient header, 6 stat cards, upcoming tasks section
